## 🙋 Getting help

> [!NOTE]
> Questions go to Discussions, bugs go to issues, vulnerabilities go through the security policy.

| I want to...           | Go to                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ask a question         | [Discussions](https://github.com/yichenzhu1337/rspack-plugin-svg-sprite/discussions)                                      |
| Report a bug           | [Bug report form](https://github.com/yichenzhu1337/rspack-plugin-svg-sprite/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)           |
| Suggest a feature      | [Feature request form](https://github.com/yichenzhu1337/rspack-plugin-svg-sprite/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Report a vulnerability | [Security policy](https://github.com/yichenzhu1337/rspack-plugin-svg-sprite/security/policy)                              |

### 🔍 Before you ask

Check the Troubleshooting section of the [README](../README.md) and search existing issues and discussions.

### 💡 What helps

- Package version, bundler and version, and whether you use inline or extract mode
- Node.js version and operating system
- Your loader rule and plugin config
- A minimal reproduction (a public repository, or a fork of the [StackBlitz starter](https://stackblitz.com/github/yichenzhu1337/rspack-plugin-svg-sprite/tree/main/starters/stackblitz))
- Build output or console errors
